description: The image displays a satellite view of an agricultural landscape characterized by extensive irrigation. The most prominent features are numerous circular fields, indicative of center-pivot irrigation systems. These circular fields vary in size and exhibit shades of dark green (active vegetation) and lighter brown/green (potentially harvested or fallow land). They are interspersed with irregularly shaped rectangular or polygonal agricultural fields. Several small to medium-sized, blue-coloured water bodies, likely reservoirs or ponds used for irrigation, are also scattered across the landscape. Patches of darker green vegetation, possibly natural forests or denser vegetation, are visible at the edges and between the cultivated areas. This imagery showcases a managed agricultural environment with intensive land use.
